$comment: W3-09 recorded call (W3-02's format, extended): start, routes (field-api's recorded answers per voice route, in order; the last repeats), reporterTurns (one session run each), agentTurns (the dialog model's recorded turns). `extraction` names the eval case (fixtures/transcripts, expected, tool-outputs) whose recorded tool output EXTRACT_PROVIDER=fake replays for this call's update_draft; `answers` are the reporter's words record_answer sends.
